title: Bangkok, six Thailand provinces on tidal flood alert until Nov. 5

blocks.text: BANGKOK — Bangkok and six central provinces face possible flooding from high tides between October 27 and November 5, 2026, the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation (DDPM) has warned. DDPM director-general Nirat Pongsitthaworn said the alert followed a notice from the Royal Thai Navy’s Hydrographic Department concerning Chao Phraya River levels around Phra Chulachomklao
